title: Queue-flake anchor: src/plugin-artifact-forward-conversion.test.ts
body:
`src/plugin-artifact-forward-conversion.test.ts` has ejected **3 distinct pull requests** from the merge queue
within a rolling 24 hours. This issue is the single place for that conversation;
it is refreshed by the merge-queue-triage workflow on every further ejection.

| PR | queue build |
|---|---|
| #12843 | [33140380738](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/33140380738) |
| #12851 | [33141029941](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/33141029941) |
| #12855 | [33141213420](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/33141213420) |

**This issue is a NAME, not a diagnosis.** The workflow that files it reads the
failing test file path out of the job logs and counts distinct PRs; it does not
know whether this is a flake, a load/timing cliff, a semantic conflict between
queued PRs, or a real regression, and it does not act on any of those. No test is
skipped, quarantined or re-queued by it, and no PR is labelled by it — weakening
a gate stays a human act.

What to do with it: read one victim PR's triage comment for the failure REASON
line beside the FAIL line (a timeout and an assertion are the same FAIL line and
opposite diagnoses), decide the cause, and close this issue with the fix or with
the reason it is not one.

Last refreshed by queue build [33141213420](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/33141213420) (PR #12855).
